lines.text: Many learners say: I got a bad note in math.
Better: I got a bad grade in math.
Grade! I got a good grade.

en.tip: English “note” means “Notiz”. A school “Note” is a “grade”.
en.caption: School note? Say grade! Wrong: “I got a bad note in math.” Right: “I got a bad grade in math.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
